{{Vanilla|Gold Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Native gold''' is the renamed gold ore.

The deepslate variant is '''native deepslate gold'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla gold ore.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1 raw gold; adamant tools drop a gold ingot. Needs an iron or better pickaxe. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref>

Both variants apply [[Fortune]] and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] intrinsic to the raw gold, one after the other, like other ores.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_gold_ore.json}}</ref> Gold ingots from adamant tools get the Fortune and electrum bonuses from both blocks.

{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3, and in the 26.3 port, the raw gold entry of stone native gold is still written in the 26.2 loot format, so its bonuses are probably not applied there. See [[Known bugs#In the 26.3 port]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>
